input: scheduled: continue work on the repo (develop, deploy, market revenue software); merge when done

doc_friction.issue: Not run by run_venture_tests.py's quick path, only inside ventures-tests.yml's step, so a new venture's CSV exporter passes its own suite and fails later; copying voltage-drop-calculator's newer exporter would have avoided it.

deviations.why: Built a calculator-shaped tool despite the depth-over-calculators default: it is a network solver (branches, transformers, motors in parallel) with complex impedances, and it found that the point-to-point magnitude sum reads 5.6 % low at the small end-of-feeder panels where ratings are decided, which a chat answer would not show.
deviations.result: merged with tests; usage not yet measured

notes: Explore idea: fault-current-check, available fault current at every panel (service transformer kVA/%Z/X/R with tolerance and utility MVA, or a known utility figure; motor contribution; feeder tree with sets, steel/PVC conduit, step-down transformers), complex (ohmic) solve plus a magnitude-sum solve equal to point-to-point f/M (tested), X/R, IEC 60909 peak, kA rating check, NEC 110.24 label text, CSV. R from geometry + IACS + IEC 60287 skin effect. Guide page and blog post; linked from service-load-check and voltage-drop-calculator. Verification: venture suite 25 pass; voltage-drop-calculator 26 and service-load-check 41 pass; site page checks pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes 12/14 then two real failures fixed (csv formula guard pattern; .grid[hidden] so the inactive source fields hide), csv guard script and its unittest OK, portfolio-pages.yml 12/12 run steps pass on rerun (21 not run: uses/deploy steps). Playwright 390px: no console errors, no horizontal scroll, example, known-source toggle and error path work. Next if it pays off: line-to-neutral faults on center-tapped secondaries and arc-flash incident energy from the same network.
